# MyST documentation plugin fixture

`myst-documentation-plugin.mjs` is copied unchanged from
[`jupyter-book/mystmd`, revision `59fb1f4d0578c84df4cd6f30e0a546515d617c70`, `docs/directives.mjs`](https://github.com/jupyter-book/mystmd/blob/59fb1f4d0578c84df4cd6f30e0a546515d617c70/docs/directives.mjs).
It is used to verify real generated directive documentation and role references,
including the example in issue #1. The upstream MIT license is included as
`MYSTMD-LICENSE`.
